items.text: Among patients with type 2 diabetes due for kidney testing in the 31 network practices between March and September 2026, are those in practices with dashboard version 2 more likely to complete both tests than those in practices still on version 1, adjusting for practice baseline?
items.population: Patients with type 2 diabetes due or overdue for kidney testing in the 31 practices
items.intervention: Practice on dashboard version 2 from March 2026 (exposure)
items.outcome: Both eGFR and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio resulted within the window

finer: Feasible with existing extracts and logs; interesting to the network and practices; novel in testing the patient list feature; ethical as evaluation of routine care under governance approval; relevant before the second wave.
summary: One PECO question on completed testing across the staggered rollout.
